It is\ndeliberately self-contained: a single SQLite database, a handful of domain\nclasses, and Symfony `HttpFoundation` + `Routing` for HTTP handling.\n\n## Quick start\n\nInstall dependencies (already vendored in this workspace):\n\n```bash\ncomposer install\n```\n\nStart the server in the foreground on the port defined by the `PORT`\nenvironment variable:\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` first calls `reset.php` to clear legacy JSON files and truncate the\nSQLite data tables, then launches PHP's built-in server bound to\n`127.0.0.1:$PORT` using `index.php` as the router script.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# Expected: {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nReset persisted state:\n\n```bash\ncurl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/storage/reset\n# Expected: {\"ok\":true,\"schema_version\":1}\n```\n\n## Project layout\n\n```\n.\n├── index.php              # Entry point: bootstrap storage, build routes, dispatch requests\n├── reset.php              # Pre-startup database reset (used by run.sh)\n├── run.sh                 # Foreground server startup\n├── composer.json          # Pins Symfony HttpFoundation 8.1.1 and Symfony Routing 8.1.0\n├── src/\n│   ├── Storage/\n│   │   └── GameStorage.php       # All SQLite schema, queries and reset logic\n│   ├── Domain/\n│   │   ├── Dice.php              # Dice expression parsing and statistics\n│   │   ├── Initiative.php        # Deterministic initiative sorting\n│   │   ├── Encounter.php         # Encounter difficulty / adjusted XP\n│   │   ├── CharacterRules.php    # Ability modifiers, proficiency, derived stats\n│   │   ├── RestRules.php         # Spell slots, long rest, equipment load\n│   │   ├── SpellRules.php        # Class-based spell validation\n│   │   └── CampaignAnalytics.php # Campaign readiness/risk scoring\n│   ├── Http/\n│   │   ├── HttpException.php     # Domain exception carrying HTTP status code\n│   │   ├── HttpHelper.php        # JSON body parsing and error responses\n│   │   ├── AuthHelper.php        # Bearer-token authentication and role checks\n│   │   └── Controllers.php       # One method per HTTP route\n│   ├── Routing/\n│   │   └── Router.php            # RouteCollection definition\n│   └── Util/\n│       └── Numbers.php           # Whole-number float normalisation\n└── game.db                # Runtime SQLite database (created on first boot)\n```\n\n## Entry point and routing\n\n`index.php` performs the following steps on every request:\n\n1. Loads `vendor/autoload.php`.\n2. Creates `App\\Storage\\GameStorage`, which ensures the SQLite schema exists.\n3. Creates `App\\Http\\Controllers`; `App\\Routing\\Router` builds the\n   `RouteCollection` from that instance.\n4. Builds a `Request` from globals once, then derives a `RequestContext` from\n   it and creates a `UrlMatcher`.\n5. Matches the incoming `Request` against the route collection.\n6. Calls the matched controller callable with `($request, $parameters)`.\n7. Catches `App\\Http\\HttpException` → JSON error response with the carried\n   status code (400/401/403/409), then `ResourceNotFoundException` → 404 and\n   `MethodNotAllowedException` → 405.\n8. Sends the resulting `JsonResponse`.\n\nAll route definitions are in `src/Routing/Router.php`. Controller methods are\nordinary public methods on `Controllers`; they are registered as\n`[$controllers, 'methodName']` callables. This keeps the dispatch code in\n`index.php` tiny and makes the routing table easy to scan. `Router` uses small\nprivate `get`/`post`/`put` helpers to reduce the visual noise of the Symfony\n`Route` constructor arguments.\n\nAuthentication/authorization is handled through `AuthHelper` so controllers do\nnot repeat the same bearer-token and role checks. `HttpException` lets a\ncontroller fail fast with the same status codes and messages the original\nimplementation returned manually; `index.php` translates the exception into a\nuniform JSON response.\n\n## State and persistence\n\nAll persistent state lives in a single SQLite database (`game.db`). The schema is\ncreated idempotently by `GameStorage::initialize()` on every request if the\ntables do not exist. Foreign keys are enabled.\n\nTables:\n\n- `schema_version` — single-row schema marker (currently version 1).\n- `users` — username, password hash (bcrypt), role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `combat_sessions` / `combat_conditions` — round, turn index, initiative order\n  and conditions tied to a combat target.\n- `compendium_monsters` / `compendium_items` — monster and item entries keyed\n  by slug.\n- `campaigns` / `campaign_characters` / `campaign_events` — campaign data,\n  characters, and log entries.\n- `quests` / `quest_milestones` — quest tracking with milestone completion.\n- `campaign_factions` / `campaign_npcs` — faction and NPC relationship tracking.\n- `campaign_inventory` — party and character item ownership.\n- `downtime_crafting` — crafting project progress.\n- `campaign_sessions` / `session_attendance` — session scheduling and RSVP.\n- `play_campaigns` / `play_campaign_members` / `play_campaign_narrations` /\n  `play_campaign_documents` — collaborative play-campaign turn queue,\n  narration log, and shared document.\n- `play_campaign_scenes` / `play_campaign_locations` /\n  `play_campaign_location_connections` / `play_campaign_encounters` —\n  scene graph, travel edges, and active encounters.\n- `play_campaign_character_spells` — known spells per character.\n\n`GameStorage::reset()` truncates all data tables, re-seeds the schema version,\nand deletes legacy `.combat-state.json` / `.users.json` files. `reset.php`\nperforms this before the server starts, and `run.sh` no longer duplicates the\ntruncate list. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint also calls\n`GameStorage::reset()` at runtime.\n\n`GameStorage::initialize()` also performs lightweight column migrations via\n`addColumnIfMissing()` so older copies of `game.db` gain new columns (e.g.\n`play_campaigns.current_actor`, `campaign_inventory.source`) automatically.\n\n## Domain groupings\n\nThe API surface is grouped by URL prefix:\n\n| Prefix `/v1/auth/...` | Authentication | `POST /v1/auth/register`, `POST /v1/auth/login` |\n| `/v1/compendium/...` | Monster/item compendium | `POST /v1/compendium/monsters`, `GET /v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}` |\n| `/v1/campaigns/...` | Campaign management | `POST /v1/campaigns`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/characters`, `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/events`, `GET /v1/campaigns/{id}/state`, plus quests, factions, NPCs, inventory, crafting, sessions, audit, export and analytics |\n| `/v1/phb/...` | Player's Handbook helpers | `POST /v1/phb/spell-slots`, `POST /v1/phb/rests/long`, `POST /v1/phb/equipment-load` |\n| `/v1/dm/...` | DM utilities | `POST /v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `POST /v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `POST /v1/dm/session-recap` |\n| character ownership/claims, level progression, skill checks and spellbook state |\n\nValidation rules, response shapes, and status codes are intentionally preserved\nfrom the previous stage. The controllers do HTTP-specific validation; pure\narithmetic and sorting live in `src/Domain/` so they are reused across endpoints\n(e.g. initiative sorting and encounter difficulty). The method signature is\n  `methodName(Request $request, array $parameters): JsonResponse`.\n- **Keep domain logic pure.** If a calculation is used by more than one endpoint,\n  place it in `src/Domain/`. WHERE id = ?');\n                $upd->execute([$newRemaining, $row['id']]);\n            } else {\n                $del = $this->pdo->prepare('DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE id = ?');\n                $del->execute([$row['id']]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = ?, turn_index = ? WHERE id = ?');\n        $upd->execute([$newRound, $newIndex, $id]);\n\n        $session['round'] = $newRound;\n        $session['turn_index'] = $newIndex;\n        $session['conditions'] = $this->getConditionsMap($id);\n        foreach ($session['order'] as $combatant) {\n            $name = $combatant['name'];\n            if (!isset($session['conditions'][$name])) {\n                $session['conditions'][$name] = [];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $session;\n    }\n\n    public function createMonster(array $data): bool\n    {\n        try {\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('INSERT INTO compendium_monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points, tags_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)');\n            $stmt->execute([\n                $data['slug'],\n                $data['name'],\n                $data['cr'],\n                $data['armor_class'],\n                $data['hit_points'],\n                json_encode($data['tags'] ?? WHERE campaign_id = ?       throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function damagePlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target, int $amount): ?array\n    {\n        $monster = $characterId, string $outcome): ?array\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return null;\n      $successes++;\n            if ($successes >= 3) {\n                $status = 'stable';\n            }\n        } elseif ($outcome === 'failure') {\n            $failures++;\n            if ($failures >= 3) {\n                $status = 'dead';\n            }\n        }\n\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_members SET death_save_successes = ?, death_save_failures = AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        $combatants = json_decode($row['combatants_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($combatants as $c) {\n            if (($c['member'] ?? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $status, $successes, $failures, $campaignId, $username]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current initiative order for an encounter.\n     *\n     * If a stored order exists it is used; otherwise the order is computed\n     * deterministically from monster and member initiatives and persisted.\n     * The returned entries include an internal 'member' key for ownership checks.\n     */\n    private function resolveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        $stored = null;\n        if ($row && !empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            $stored = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if ($stored === null || count($stored) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        $order = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $stored, $combatantsJson);\n        if (count($order) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute a sorted order entry list from current monsters and members.\n     */\n    private function computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? ORDER BY name');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $entries = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'monster',\n                'id' => $row['monster_id'],\n                'name' => $row['name'],\n                'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'member',\n                'id' => $c['member'] ?? '',\n                'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n            ];\n        }\n\n        usort($entries, static function (array $a, array $b): int {\n            if ($a['initiative'] !== $b['initiative']) {\n                return $b['initiative'] <=> $a['initiative'];\n            }\n\n            return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);\n        });\n\n        return array_map(static fn (array $e): array => ['kind' => $e['kind'], 'id' => $e['id']], $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Hydrate stored order entries into full combatant records.\n     */\n    private function hydrateEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $memberMap = [];\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $memberMap[$c['member'] ?? ''] = $c;\n        }\n\n        $order = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            $kind = $entry['kind'] ?? '';\n            $id = $entry['id'] ?? '';\n            if ($kind === 'monster') {\n                $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $id);\n                if ($m === null) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => $m['name'],\n                    'kind' => 'monster',\n                    'initiative' => $m['initiative'],\n                    'monster_id' => $m['monster_id'],\n                    'member' => null,\n                    'character_id' => null,\n                ];\n            } elseif ($kind === 'member' && isset($memberMap[$id])) {\n                $c = $memberMap[$id];\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                    'kind' => 'member',\n                    'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n                    'member' => $c['member'] ?? null,\n                    'character_id' => $c['character_id'] ?? null,\n                    'monster_id' => null,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Persist the order entry list for an encounter.\n     */\n    private function saveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $combatantsJson = $row['combatants_json'];\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        if (count($entries) === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $newFull = null;\n        if ($newEntry['kind'] === 'monster') {\n            $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $newEntry['id']);\n            if ($m !== null) {\n                $newFull = ['name' => $m['name'], 'initiative' => $m['initiative']];\n            }\n        } else {\n            $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n            foreach ($members as $c) {\n                if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $newEntry['id']) {\n                    $newFull = ['name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''), 'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0)];\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if ($newFull === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $insertIndex = count($entries);\n        $full = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        foreach ($full as $i => $entry) {\n            if ($newFull['initiative'] > $entry['initiative']\n                || ($newFull['initiative'] === $entry['initiative'] && strcmp($newFull['name'], $entry['name']) < 0)) {\n                $insertIndex = $i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        array_splice($entries, $insertIndex, 0, [$newEntry]);\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Remove a combatant from the stored order, if one exists.\n     */\n    private function removeEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $kind, string $id): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n            $upd->execute([$newRound, $newTurnIndex, $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'round' => $newRound,\n                'turn_index' => $newTurnIndex,\n                'active' => $order[$newTurnIndex] ?? null,\n                'order' => $order,\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Move the current combatant to a later position in the initiative order.\n     *\n     * Returns null if the encounter is missing, or an array with 'error' =>\n     * 'invalid index' if the requested index is not a valid later position.\n     */\n    public function delayPlayCampaignEncounterTurn(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, int $newIndex): ?array\n    {\n        $this->pdo->exec('BEGIN IMMEDIATE');\n        try {\n            $turn = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterTurn($campaignId, $encounterId);\n            if ($turn === null) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return null;\n            }\n\n            $order = $turn['order'];\n            $count = count($order);\n            $turnIndex = $turn['turn_index'];\n            if ($newIndex <= $turnIndex || $newIndex >= $count || $count <= 1) {\n                $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n\n                return ['error' => 'invalid index', 'order' => $order];\n            }\n\n            $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json, combatants_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? '[]', true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n\n            $current = array_splice($entries, $turnIndex, 1)[0];\n            array_splice($entries, $newIndex, 0, [$current]);\n\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n            $upd = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET turn_index = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n            $upd->execute([$newIndex, $campaignId, $encounterId]);\n            $this->pdo->exec('COMMIT');\n\n            return [\n                'order' => $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $row['combatants_json']),\n            ];\n        } catch (\\Throwable $e) {\n            $this->pdo->exec('ROLLBACK');\n            throw $e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function damagePlayCampaignEncounterCombatant(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $target, int $amount): ?array\n    {\n        $monster = $characterId, string $outcome): ?array\n    {\n        $member = $this->getPlayCampaignMemberByCharacterId($campaignId, $characterId);\n        if ($member === null) {\n            return null;\n      $successes++;\n            if ($successes >= 3) {\n                $status = 'stable';\n            }\n        } elseif ($outcome === 'failure') {\n            $failures++;\n            if WHERE campaign_id = ? AND username = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$hpCurrent, $status, $successes, $failures, $campaignId, $username]);\n\n        return $stmt->rowCount() > 0;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Resolve the current initiative order for an encounter.\n     *\n     * If a stored order exists it is used; otherwise the order is computed\n     * deterministically from monster and member initiatives and persisted.\n     * The returned entries include an internal 'member' key for ownership checks.\n     */\n    private function resolveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        $stored = null;\n        if ($row && !empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            $stored = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        }\n\n        if ($stored === null || count($stored) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        $order = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $stored, $combatantsJson);\n        if (count($order) === 0) {\n            $entries = $this->computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $combatantsJson);\n            $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n\n            return $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Compute a sorted order entry list from current monsters and members.\n     */\n    private function computeSortedEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT monster_id, name, initiative FROM play_campaign_encounter_monsters WHERE campaign_id = ? AND encounter_id = ? ORDER BY name');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $entries = [];\n        foreach ($stmt->fetchAll() as $row) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'monster',\n                'id' => $row['monster_id'],\n                'name' => $row['name'],\n                'initiative' => (int) $row['initiative'],\n            ];\n        }\n\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $entries[] = [\n                'kind' => 'member',\n                'id' => $c['member'] ?? '',\n                'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n            ];\n        }\n\n        usort($entries, static function (array $a, array $b): int {\n            if ($a['initiative'] !== $b['initiative']) {\n                return $b['initiative'] <=> $a['initiative'];\n            }\n\n            return strcmp($a['name'], $b['name']);\n        });\n\n        return array_map(static fn (array $e): array => ['kind' => $e['kind'], 'id' => $e['id']], $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Hydrate stored order entries into full combatant records.\n     */\n    private function hydrateEncounterOrderEntries(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries, string $combatantsJson): array\n    {\n        $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        $memberMap = [];\n        foreach ($members as $c) {\n            $memberMap[$c['member'] ?? ''] = $c;\n        }\n\n        $order = [];\n        foreach ($entries as $entry) {\n            $kind = $entry['kind'] ?? '';\n            $id = $entry['id'] ?? '';\n            if ($kind === 'monster') {\n                $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $id);\n                if ($m === null) {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => $m['name'],\n                    'kind' => 'monster',\n                    'initiative' => $m['initiative'],\n                    'monster_id' => $m['monster_id'],\n                    'member' => null,\n                    'character_id' => null,\n                ];\n            } elseif ($kind === 'member' && isset($memberMap[$id])) {\n                $c = $memberMap[$id];\n                $order[] = [\n                    'name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''),\n                    'kind' => 'member',\n                    'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0),\n                    'member' => $c['member'] ?? null,\n                    'character_id' => $c['character_id'] ?? null,\n                    'monster_id' => null,\n                ];\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $order;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Persist the order entry list for an encounter.\n     */\n    private function saveEncounterOrder(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, array $entries): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('UPDATE play_campaign_encounters SET order_json = ? AND id = ?');\n        $stmt->execute([$campaignId, $encounterId]);\n        $row = $stmt->fetch();\n        if (!$row || empty($row['order_json'])) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $combatantsJson = $row['combatants_json'];\n        $entries = json_decode($row['order_json'], true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n        if (count($entries) === 0) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $newFull = null;\n        if ($newEntry['kind'] === 'monster') {\n            $m = $this->getPlayCampaignEncounterMonster($campaignId, $encounterId, $newEntry['id']);\n            if ($m !== null) {\n                $newFull = ['name' => $m['name'], 'initiative' => $m['initiative']];\n            }\n        } else {\n            $members = json_decode($combatantsJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);\n            foreach ($members as $c) {\n                if (($c['member'] ?? '') === $newEntry['id']) {\n                    $newFull = ['name' => (string) ($c['name'] ?? ''), 'initiative' => (int) ($c['initiative'] ?? 0)];\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if ($newFull === null) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $insertIndex = count($entries);\n        $full = $this->hydrateEncounterOrderEntries($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries, $combatantsJson);\n        foreach ($full as $i => $entry) {\n            if ($newFull['initiative'] > $entry['initiative']\n                || ($newFull['initiative'] === $entry['initiative'] && strcmp($newFull['name'], $entry['name']) < 0)) {\n                $insertIndex = $i;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        array_splice($entries, $insertIndex, 0, [$newEntry]);\n        $this->saveEncounterOrder($campaignId, $encounterId, $entries);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Remove a combatant from the stored order, if one exists.\n     */\n    private function removeEncounterOrderEntry(string $campaignId, string $encounterId, string $kind, string $id): void\n    {\n        $stmt = $this->pdo->prepare('SELECT order_json FROM play_campaign_encounters WHERE campaign_id = ?
